out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: Management was not able to produce a written Employee Health Policy.
violations.corrective_action: A complete employee health policy must have the following elements: 1) Employee training on foodborne illness, particularly symptoms of illness and prevention of the Big Six illnesses (see 'What is Foodborne Illness' handout); and 2) Documentation that employees have been instructed of their responsibility to report symptoms of, diagnosis of or exposure to foodborne illness to management (see 'Employee Illness Reporting Agreement' handout); and 3) A management plan to restrict or exclude employees, as applicable, who have symptoms, diagnosis or exposure to foodborne illness (see 'Employee Illness Decision Guide for PIC/CFM' handout). The information provided at the time of this inspection will help you develop and implement this policy. Handouts are available in the following languages: English, Arabic, Chinese (traditional), Farsi, Hindi, Korean, Spanish, Thai, Urdu and Vietnamese. If you have any questions about your employee health policy, please contact your area inspector or contact the Health Department at 703-246-2201, TTY 703-591-6435. EHS PROVIDED HARD COPIES OF THE FAIRFAX COUNTY EMPLOYEE ILLNESS AGREEMENT FOR ALL STAFF ON SHIFT AT THE TIME OF THE INSPECTION. HAVE ALL STAFF READ AND SIGN A COPY. RETAIN ON SITE FOR FUTURE INSPECTIONS.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) pizza sauce was observed at 60f 2) white sauce was observed at 46f Upon discussion with PIC, sauces have been out for 3 hours.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC AGREED TO DISCARD THE SAUCES IN 1 HOUR. PIC DOES NOT WANT TO HAVE THE SAUCES ON TIME AS A PUBLIC HEALTH CONTROL.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Ice As Coolant Not Used as Food
violations.observation: Observed a bottle of water and an ice cube tray being stored inside the ice bin at the bar.
violations.corrective_action: After use as a medium for cooling the exterior surfaces of food, packaged foods, beverages, or cooling coils/tubes, the ice may not be used as food. MANAGEMENT DISCARDED THE BOTTLE OF WATER AND REMOVED THE ICE TRAY. EHS DISCUSSED WITH MANAGEMENT TO REMOVE OLD ICE FROM THE BIN AND REPLACE WITH NEW ICE FROM THE ICE MACHINE

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Equip/Utensils/Linens Stored off Floor, Clean Location
violations.observation: Observed clean linens, mop heads, and plastic food storage containers being stored in a plastic utility shed outside by the parking lot. Plastic utility shed was observed with one attached door exposing all of the clean equipment and linens to contaminates. The detached door was observed lying in the grass next to the plastic utility sheds. Plastic utility sheds were observed with no locking mechanism potentially exposing equipment and linens to tampering.
violations.corrective_action: Store clean equipment, utensils, and linens in a clean, dry location where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination and at least 6 inches above the floor. REPAIR OR REPLACE UTILITY SHEDS TO ENSURE EQUIPMENT, LINENS, ETC. REMAINS PROTECTED FROM TAMPERING OR CONTAMINATION. CORRECT BY THE NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Fixed Equipment, Properly Spaced and Sealed
violations.observation: The following equipment is not installed in a manner that allows accessibility for cleaning, nor is it installed with closely abutting surfaces to minimize the need for cleaning: 1) hand sink by the pizza topping prep top cooler 2) right hand corner of the 3 compartment sink
violations.corrective_action: Equipment that is fixed because it is not easily movable shall be installed so that it is: 1) spaced to allow access for cleaning along the sides, behind, and above the equipment, 2) spaced from adjoining equipment, walls, and ceilings a distance of not more than 1 millimeter or one thirty-second inch, and 3) sealed to adjoining equipment or walls if the equipment is exposed to spillage or seepage. RE-CAULK SINK BACK TO THE WALL. CORRECT BY THE NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the mop sink with an unapproved Y splitter attached to the faucet
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. EHS PROVIDED MANAGEMENT WITH INFORMATION FOR AN APPROVED BACKFLOW PREVENTION DEVICE. ORDER AND INSTALL. SEND EHS PHOTOGRAPHIC VERIFICATION ONCE INSTALLED PUPATELLA (Inspection Date: 06/27/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: Observed several bulk bins of dry ingredients without a label. Observed a silver spray bottle of oil without a label.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. MANAGEMENT LABELED THE BULK BINS AND THE SPRAY BOTTLE DURING THE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Durable/Smooth Materials
violations.observation: Observed aluminum foil used to line the bottom shelf of a prep table.
violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other foods that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a corrosion- resistant, nonabsorbent, and smooth material. EHS DISCUSSED WITH MANAGEMENT TO REMOVE THE FOIL TO PREVENT HARBORAGE CONDITIONS.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed an unapproved Y splitter on the mop sink
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. EHS PROVIDED MANAGEMENT WITH INFORMATION FOR AN APPROVED BACKFLOW PREVENTION DEVICE. PLEASE ORDER AND INSTALL.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: Pizza sauce on the counter was observed at 61f. Upon discussion with PIC, pizza sauce was placed on the counter 3 hours prior.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC AGREED TO DISCARD THE PIZZA SAUCE ON THE COUNTER IN 1 HOUR. MOVING FORWARD, PIC AGREED TO KEEP PIZZA SAUCE ON ICE. ENSURE PIZZA SAUCE IS KEPT AT 41f OR COLDER.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed a box of moldy corn in walk-in.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. PIC DISCARDED THE CORN.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: flour, rice, oil, truffle oil, etc.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. PLEASE LABEL ALL FOOD STORAGE CONTAINER INCLUDING BULK BINS AND SPRAY/SQUEEZE BOTTLES.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: The hose/faucet at the three compartment sink was observed leaking.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. PLEASE FIX THE LEAKING HOSE/FAUCET.

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Chlorine Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the low temperature, chemical sanitizing warewashing machine was observed with a sanitizing rinse concentration of less than 50 ppm chlorine solution. Detergent and Sanitizer lines were observed incorrectly connected to the dish machine, causing the sanitizer to dispense in the first cycle of the wash.
violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the three-compartment sink to manually wash, rinse and sanitize food-contact surfaces using a sanitizing solution at the proper concentration of at least 50 to 200 ppm total chlorine. Auto-Chlor was contacted while inspector was on-site and scheduled for maintenance of the machine. The 3-compartment sink was set up for use and tested at 400ppm quaternary ammonia.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at the handwashing sink at the bar.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands.

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: 2 door display refrigerator near gelato cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: food storage bin used to dispense tomato sauce observed in walk-in refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. Replace with handled scoop to prevent contact with the foods.

violations.title: Air Gaps/Breaks
violations.observation: An air gap between the water supply outlet of the ice cream scoop holder and the flood rim level is not observed.
violations.corrective_action: An air gap between the water supply inlet and the flood level rim of the plumbing fixture, equipment, or nonfood equipment shall be at least twice the diameter of the water supply inlet and may not be less than one inch.
